After clear_selection, nothing is selected: every node and edge is plain." width="100%"} Resets the selection state, unmarking all previously selected nodes and edges. Useful for starting fresh with a new selection workflow. ::: ## Returns {.doc-returns} ::: {.doc-definition-items} [Graph]{.doc-parameter-annotation} : Self for method chaining. ::: ## Examples {.doc-examples} ::: {#90139c19 .cell execution_count=1} ``` {.python .cell-code} import edgecase as ec graph = ( ec.Graph() .add_star_graph(5) .select_nodes_by_degree(min_degree=3) .clear_selection() ) graph.count_selected_nodes() ``` ::: {.cell-output .cell-output-display execution_count=1} ``` 0 ``` ::: :::
